title: the Free Port Rising Revisited
author: Coral Marchetti
blurb: Sable Halloran, a whistle-blower living under four names, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
